name: Hasekura Akane
source:
St. Ao Academy 2nd year high school student. B class.
Secretary with the Student Council.

An energetic and optimistic girl who is a little confident in her physical strength.
A curious girl who cant settle down until she investigates anything that interests her.
Seven years earlier a mysterious woman gave her a fragment of a jewel and that was the start of her getting wrapped up in an incident.
Whenever she thinks of somebody and opens her palm, the half chipped jewel of light will appear.
